::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 11th, 1883  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

My dear [Lady Sophia](people/person_1133.qmd)[^1]

Pray tell [Sir Arthur Gordon](people/person_568.qmd) that I shall be very grateful for his Christmas papers.[^2]

We are preparing for a huge [G F S](organizations/other_23.qmd) festival at [St Cross](organizations/other_130.qmd), and watching the clouds with alarm

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Lady Sophia Palmer (1852-1915), was the daughter of Lord Selborne, who had been raised to an earldom on 29 December 1882.
[^2]: The Hon. Sir Arthur Gordon (1829-1912), created (1893) Lord Stanmore, moved in 1883 from being Governor-General of New Zealand to being Governor-General of Ceylon.
